correctness.rationale: Standard stable-sort permutation is one 8-cycle exactly for primitive necklaces, and input cyclic-run count is Hamming(L,sorted(L)). For any letter with odd count 2u+1 and too many coincident entries, the stable permutation has a fixed point, impossible. Hence sharp four-run inputs must have even counts <=4. Exhaustive exact independent enumeration of the resulting 3,850 reduced multiset words recovered 6 patterns with rows 0,1,1,1,3; order-preserving embeddings prove formula for all q. Four-letter direct construction is supplementary.
residual_risks: Independent finite checks are bounded; full quantifiers depend on inspected analytic or finite-exhaustive reduction arguments.
